East: a long, low, lean rat in full side profile, stalking. It has scruffy, patchy tan-grey fur with darker mottling along the spine, wrinkled pinkish-grey skin showing on the legs and belly, a long snout with small bared teeth, a wispy pale chin tuft, tall tufted ears, long dark-clawed paws and a very long thin ringed tail. North: the same animal from behind. It shows its back, haunches, hind feet and a tail hanging straight down toward the camera, with the backs of its ears at the top and no face. While womp rats were opportunists and fond of carrion, they were also predators. Body mass is the same in every facing: the front view's broad shoulders and chest, the side view's substantial rump, and the rear view's wide hunched haunches, thick rump and substantial dark paws planted wide all carry equal bulk and fill the same width at the same height. The rear view is seen from behind, showing back, tail and haunches, with eyes hidden. Keep the palette, fur colouring and body plan identical to the previous render. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour, clean dark outline. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard: three near-spherical, swollen golden leathery sacs with fine wrinkle and vein texture and no fins, tail, scales or eyes. South has one large ringed crater-mouth in the centre facing the viewer, one on top and partial mouths on the left and right edges. East has a mouth upper left, a large one on the right edge and one lower left, so the sac is turned about a quarter. North has a mouth on top and mouths on the left and right edges, and nothing in the centre. All three are about the same size. The painting is soft and realistic, with a thin dark edge and no heavy keyline.
observed.south.png: A taut golden sac, slightly wider than tall. A big crater-mouth with a ribbed rim and a dark throat looks straight at the camera. A smaller mouth sits on top, opening upward, and two more show as half-moons on the left and right sides. The skin has wrinkles and raised vein lines. Transparent background, no shadow.
observed.east.png: The same golden sac seen from a different side. The crater-mouths sit upper left, right and lower left, with smoother skin between them. Nothing reads as a front or a back; it is a rolled-around view of the same globe. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: The golden sac with a mouth on top opening upward and two mouths on the left and right flanks. The centre is plain skin with wrinkle lines, and there is no front-facing mouth. No eyes or face. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the sac sits in its cell beside the vanilla human and is about half to two-thirds the width of the human's head, a small round gold ball. At normal play (32 px per cell) it is a tiny gold-orange speck, smaller than the rat.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: A faceless sac, so its 'front' is the large central crater-mouth facing the camera on south; that reads as the front surface.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows plain wrinkled skin in the centre, with mouths only on the top and flanks. No eyes or face.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three views show the globe from the side, with a top mouth opening upward and the side mouths foreshortened. None is a plan view.

ALIEN.seen: A finless, eyeless, tailless golden bladder pocked with ringed mouths. Nobody would name it a pufferfish or any other Earth animal at first glance; it reads as an alien organism, maybe a gourd or seed pod.
